Mach Fighter
■ Whenever this creature wins a battle, draw a card.
■ Psychic Chance: Whenever one of your nature creatures attacks, you may put this card from your hand into the hyperspatial zone. If you do, that creature gets +4000 power until the end of the turn.
■ You may summon this creature from your hyperspatial zone.
